status: proposed research directions; evidence and assumptions separated
scope: Linked selected supply-stage and U.S. application evidence; not a complete national factory census or calibrated cost optimizer.

questions.question_en: Where is usable magnet demand, and which chosen applications face disruption or switching constraints?
questions.question_zh: 合格可用磁体的需求在哪里？哪些已选定的应用面临中断或切换约束？
questions.description_en: Separate the magnet or rotor, motor/actuator maker, integrator, application factory and final use. A household, industrial facility, business or infrastructure project may be the endpoint. Annual units or announced factory capacity cannot establish magnet mass without the actual design and material bill.
questions.description_zh: 区分磁体或转子、电机/执行器厂、集成商、应用工厂与最终用途。终端可能是家庭、工业设施、企业或基础设施项目。没有实际设计及材料清单，年产数量或公布产能不能推出磁体用量。

inputs.label_en: Documented plant/product, buyer role and dated relationship
inputs.label_zh: 具名厂点/产品、采购角色及注明时间的关系

inputs.label_en: Actual annual output and planned/design capacity, kept separate
inputs.label_zh: 实际年度产量与计划/设计产能分别记录

inputs.label_en: Magnet chemistry/mass per unit, PM design share and accepted suppliers
inputs.label_zh: 每件产品磁体材质/质量、永磁路线份额及合格供应商
情景需求及认证/切换时间

outputs.label_en: Architecture-specific demand ranges with visible gaps
outputs.label_zh: 注明缺口的具体技术路线需求区间

outputs.label_en: Unmet accepted magnet demand and delivery delays
outputs.label_zh: 未满足的合格磁体需求及交付延误

limitations_en: No blanket NdFeB dependence for all EVs, robots, wind turbines or AI equipment.
No named supplier route, OEM bill of materials or receiving plant is inferred from company/product adoption.

不根据公司或产品采用关系推断具名供应路线、整机材料清单或收货厂点。

questions.question_en: Which process or acceptance stage limits delivery, and what capital and time could change it?

questions.description_en: Link the material process to its required equipment and utilities, then identify the equipment maker and actual manufacturing or service location. An operating plant, pilot, construction project and customer-qualified line represent different readiness states.
questions.description_zh: 将材料工序连接到所需设备及公用工程，再确认设备制造商及实际生产或服务地点。运行工厂、中试、在建项目及客户认证产线是不同的就绪状态。

inputs.label_en: Process, equipment capability and verified operating/planned status
inputs.label_zh: 工序、设备能力及已核实的运行/计划状态

inputs.label_en: Comparable machine quotation, capacity, yield, service and spares
inputs.label_zh: 可比设备报价、产能、收率、服务及备件

inputs.label_en: Site conditions, utilities, construction, commissioning and qualification
inputs.label_zh: 厂址条件、公用工程、建设、调试及客户认证

inputs.label_en: Assumed build, ramp and acceptance delays in the existing model
inputs.label_zh: 现有模型中的假设建设、爬坡及验收时间

outputs.label_zh: 分环节就绪状态与瓶颈敏感性
到客户可用产出所需的时间

limitations_en: Equipment purchases, material inputs and finished-component transport are different transactions.
Announced equipment or project capacity is not current qualified output.
No verified national U.S. investment total or exact plant equipment bill is available here.
Selected equipment examples establish their stated milestone only; none supplies a calibrated nationwide equipment cost or customer-qualified throughput.
limitations_zh: 设备采购、材料投入及成品部件运输是不同交易。
公布的设备或项目产能不等于当前合格产出。
此处没有已核实的全美投资总额或工厂精确设备清单。
已选设备实例仅证明所披露的节点；不能标定全国设备成本或客户合格产出。

questions.title_zh: 成本与供应安全的前沿比较
questions.question_en: Under the same budget and delivery deadline, which feasible choices reduce cost, unmet demand or delay?
questions.question_zh: 在相同预算及交付期限下，哪些可行选择减少成本、短缺或延误？
questions.description_en: Compare domestic investment, qualified allied imports, multiple accepted suppliers and finite inventory for one defined product and application. Test Chinese/allied equipment price assumptions rather than assuming one country is cheaper. Retain the options that cannot improve one objective without worsening another; then test whether the frontier survives uncertainty.
questions.description_zh: 针对一个明确的产品及应用，比较本土投资、合格盟友进口、多个已认可供应商与有限库存。检验中国/盟友设备价格的假设，而不是预设某国更便宜。保留无法在不损害另一目标的前提下继续改进的选择，再检验不确定性是否改变前沿。

inputs.label_en: Matched product/equipment delivered lifecycle cost and cost date
inputs.label_zh: 可比产品/设备的到货全生命周期成本及成本日期

inputs.label_en: Verified transport, duties, service/spares and outage exposure
inputs.label_zh: 核实的运输、税费、服务/备件及停机暴露

inputs.label_en: A common decision date, fixed supply reference, budget and deadline
inputs.label_zh: 共同决策日期、固定供应基准、预算及期限

inputs.label_en: Finite inventories, build/ramp/qualification and consistent shocks
inputs.label_zh: 有限库存、建设/爬坡/认证及一致的冲击

outputs.label_en: Pareto comparison: lifecycle cost versus unmet qualified tonnes
outputs.label_zh: 帕累托比较：生命周期成本与未满足的合格磁体吨数

outputs.label_en: Late-demand burden and time to qualified delivery
outputs.label_zh: 需求等待负担及合格交付时间

outputs.label_en: Sensitivity to prices, lead times, yields and disruption duration
outputs.label_zh: 对价格、交期、收率及中断时长的敏感性

limitations_en: Existing intervention credits are abstract scenario units, not calibrated U.S. dollars.
A frontier for a bounded product/program is not a nationwide optimum.
Do not sum overlapping project capital disclosures or compare incompatible product/cost bases.
limitations_zh: 现有干预积分是抽象情景单位，而不是校准后的美元。
特定产品或项目的前沿比较不等于全国最优解。
不累计重叠的项目资本披露，也不比较不兼容的产品或成本口径。

boundaries_en: Proposed questions are not findings. Actual source anchors stay separate from assumed demand, costs, capacity and shipping.
The supply map traces materials/process relationships; the application map locates documented downstream examples. A gap remains a gap between them.
Permanent magnets, NdFeB, SmCo and magnet-free alternatives remain distinct.
The existing model retains conserved elemental and purchased-product accounts, carrier iron counted once, fixed supply reference, an empty-pipeline choice and common decision/deadline.
Selected equipment evidence is context, not a calibrated simulation input. Equipment purchases, production feedstock shipments and finished-magnet delivery remain separate transactions.
No matched China/Japan/U.S. equipment-price ordering is verified; price differences are hypotheses requiring comparable delivered lifecycle quotations.
boundaries_zh: 研究问题是提案，而不是结论。已核实的厂点与假设需求、成本、产能及运输保持分开。
供应地图追踪材料及工序关系；应用地图展示下游实例。两者之间没有证据的环节仍保持为空缺。
永久磁体、NdFeB、SmCo 及无磁体替代路线分别处理。
现有模型保留元素及采购产品守恒、载体铁只计一次、固定供应基准、空管线选项及共同决策/期限。
所选设备证据是背景，不是经过标定的模拟输入。设备采购、生产原料运输及成品磁体交付保持为不同交易。
尚未核实中日美可比设备价格排序；价格差异是需要可比到货全生命周期报价检验的假设。

application_cases.summary_en: RoboFab is designed for up to 10,000 Digit robots/year at full capacity; actual annual output is undisclosed. GXO documents commercial Digit use in its SPANX warehouse program. A business workflow is the end use, without an identified magnet supplier.
application_cases.summary_zh: RoboFab 满产设计能力最高每年10,000台 Digit 机器人，实际年度产量未披露。GXO 记录其 SPANX 仓库项目中的 Digit 商业使用。终端是企业工作流，但未确认磁体供应商。

geographies.place_zh: 美国佐治亚州 Flowery Branch
geographies.role_en: GXO Digit 4 deployment described by Agility; business end user
geographies.role_zh: Agility 披露的 GXO Digit 4 部署；企业终端用户

metrics.scope_en: RoboFab at full capacity; not realized output
metrics.scope_zh: RoboFab 满产设计；非已实现产量

metrics.scope_en: Not disclosed in the checked records

application_cases.material_note_en: Exact magnet material, mass per eligible product, design mix, supplier allocation and customer acceptance remain unreported here. No magnet-tonnage conversion is made.
application_cases.material_note_zh: 具体磁体材质、每件合格产品的磁体质量、设计占比、供应商分配及客户验收尚未在此披露。不换算磁体吨数。
limitations_en: Commercial warehouse deployment does not reveal actuator topology, magnet chemistry or kilograms per robot.
Cumulative totes moved and announced robot orders are not annual robot output.
limitations_zh: 仓库商业部署不披露执行器架构、磁体材质或每台机器人磁体质量。
累计搬运料箱与公布的机器人订单不是机器人年度产量。

application_cases.stage_en: Mixed vehicle assembly / planned BEV program
application_cases.stage_zh: 混合车型装配 / 计划中的纯电项目
application_cases.status_en: 2025 actual X-model production; iX5 start planned December 2026
application_cases.status_zh: 2025年 X 车型实际生产；iX5 计划2026年十二月启动
application_cases.summary_en: Spartanburg made 412,799 BMW X models in 2025, including combustion and plug-in hybrid models. The planned iX5 uses rear EESM and front ASM traction: no permanent traction magnets in that specified architecture. This is not a claim about every auxiliary motor.
application_cases.summary_zh: Spartanburg 2025年生产412,799辆 BMW X 车型，包括燃油与插电混动车型。计划中的 iX5 使用后轴 EESM 和前轴 ASM 驱动，此指定架构不使用永磁牵引电机，但不能外推到所有辅助电机。

geographies.place_en: Spartanburg area, South Carolina, United States
geographies.place_zh: 美国南卡罗来纳州 Spartanburg 地区
geographies.role_en: Mixed-model production; iX5 production is a later planned milestone
geographies.role_zh: 混合车型生产；iX5 生产是较后的计划节点

metrics.scope_en: All X models, including ICE/PHEV; not BEV output
metrics.scope_zh: 全部 X 车型，包括燃油/插混；非纯电产量

metrics.label_zh: 计划 iX5 生产启动
metrics.scope_en: EESM rear / ASM front architecture; not an annual volume
metrics.scope_zh: 后轴 EESM / 前轴 ASM 架构；非年产量

application_cases.material_note_en: Do not convert all 412,799 X models into rare-earth traction-magnet demand. The specified iX5 traction architecture avoids permanent magnets; auxiliary and other-program material requirements remain separate.
application_cases.material_note_zh: 不能将全部412,799辆 X 车型换算为稀土牵引磁体需求。指定的 iX5 驱动架构不采用永磁体；辅助电机及其他项目的材料要求另行核实。
limitations_en: December 2026 is a planned start, not achieved annual output as of October 7.
No iX5 annual volume, incoming drive-unit factory/batch or magnet material bill is assigned.
limitations_zh: 截至十月七日，2026年十二月仍是计划启动，而非已实现的年度产量。
不指定 iX5 年产量、驱动单元来料工厂/批次或磁体材料清单。

application_evidence_review.status: Four selected primary-source cases checked; source packet final date/unit/scope QA passed
application_evidence_review.scope: Four cases only. Full packet contains15 named sites; this page does not display or claim to independently audit every field. No national magnet-tonnage estimate or model input added.
application_evidence_review.plot_boundary: Metric ledgers retain site/global, actual/capacity and annual/quarter scope. No unmatched utilization ratios or bars.

packet_validation.manual_scope_notes: Actual/capacity/plan/rate/company-wide/quarterly/cumulative values remain separately typed; no annualization, additive flexible capacities, ton-unit conversion or magnet-tonnage extrapolation.

application_evidence_review.display_scope: Four introductory cases plus all five sector-demand contexts, all fifteen site dossiers and the complete final packet source registry. The full index preserves original source wording; no mass extrapolation or model calibration.

demand.scope_en: All five sector-demand contexts and fifteen site dossiers from the final bounded U.S. packet. Primary source records retain publication dates separately from dates checked. No product-to-magnet mass extrapolation.
demand.scope_zh: 最终美国有限资料包中的全部五类行业需求背景和十五个地点资料。来源发布日期与核查日期分别保留，不由产品数量推断磁体质量。

us_ev_sales_2025.title_en: EVs: U.S. sales, not domestic factory output
us_ev_sales_2025.title_zh: 电动车：美国销量，不是美国工厂产量

us_robot_installations_2025.title_en: Robotics: annual installations, not magnet manufacture
us_robot_installations_2025.title_zh: 机器人：年度安装量，不是磁体制造量

us_motor_installed_stock_context.title_en: Industrial motors: installed stock and electricity
us_motor_installed_stock_context.title_zh: 工业电机：在用存量与耗电量

us_wind_plan_context.title_en: Wind: planned GW, unknown permanent-magnet share
us_wind_plan_context.title_zh: 风电：计划吉瓦数，永磁占比未知

us_household_washer_factory_context.title_en: Appliances: one factory’s undated annual-rate statement
us_household_washer_factory_context.title_zh: 家电：单厂未注明日期的年度速率表述

demand.map_link_boundary: Existing application record references only; no incoming magnet supplier, grade, batch or surveyed coordinates inferred.

readiness.scope_en: All twelve stage records, five project comparisons, the separate outstanding equipment commitment and all thirty-four source records from the final equipment packet. Complete original fields remain inspectable.
readiness.scope_zh: 最终设备资料包中的全部十二项工序记录、五项项目比较、单独的设备合同剩余承诺与三十四项来源。可展开查看全部原始字段。
readiness.map_link_boundary: Only existing named facility anchors are linked. Mountain Pass is the colocated separation context; its mine marker is not a surveyed separation-machine pin. Consarc/Vulcan RTP and Northlake do not acquire invented pins; their source dossiers remain accessible. Factory tour links are explanatory process context, not verified installed-machine reconstructions.
readiness.monetary_boundary: Project investment, capex, financing and outstanding contractual commitment are separate types. Records are not additive; no per-machine quote, country cost multiplier or national investment total is derived.
